{{Quote|Shaaks are known for their succulent meat and their hides make excellent leather. Domesticated for generations, they have extremely simple minds.|[[Lyrre T'enna]]'s notes on the Shaak|<ref name="WSW" />}}
'''Shaaks''' were plump quadrupedal herd animals native to the grasslands of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Shaaks were often raised for their meat, and had large, rotund bodies. They had relatively weak legs, however, and were barely able to keep themselves upright.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Shaak anatomy.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Anatomy of a pregnant Shaak.]]
The herbivorous shaak was a wandering animal, and was found in multiple regions of the [[Naboo/Legends|planet]]. However, they tended to seek out dry areas, and avoided Naboo's numerous swamps since they were commonly not fond of damp surroundings.<ref name=":0" /> Shaaks were, however, naturally buoyant due to their fatty bodies, though their four short legs were of little use in the water. Their inability to escape from water meant that shaaks sometimes found themselves carried over waterfalls, though their fatty bodies ensured such falls did no serious damage.<ref name="WSW" />

Female shaaks had multiple wombs, allowing for a remarkable reproduction rate. In fact, females were continually pregnant, and their compartmentalized uterine system allowed them to be impregnated by several different males at the same time.<ref name="WSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Their intestines were also very sensitive to blockages caused by chemicals, to such an extent that they would eventually explode overtime if they were fed any food laced with these chemicals.

Shaaks were domesticated for generations because of their meat, hide, and ambergris, which was used as a base for perfumes. Wild shaaks, however, were not as bulbous as the domesticated ones. Natural predators included [[Tusk cat|tusk-cats]] and [[greysor]]s.<ref name="WSW" />

Shaaks were one of the few species that, if infected with the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], would die instantly.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

A similar species could be found on the planet [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], with longer fur to suit the frigid climate. To intimidate the [[Alzoc III Food Commissioner|local food commissioner]], crime lord [[Tyber Zann]] killed several prize shaaks so that he would control most of Alzoc III's food market.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:PeppiBowHerd-BSV.png|thumb|right|250px|Peppi Bow's shaak herd drinks from a river infected with the Blue Shadow Virus.]]

Though prized for their meat by [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] alike, which could be easily stored and required little preparation before consumption,<ref name=":0" /> shaaks were seldom used as pack animals due to the fact that their abnormally large rumps made harnessing difficult, and rarely used as mounts due to their inherent instability,<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> though some herders, such as the Gungan [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]], rode them with ease.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> They were also prized for their fluff.

An herd of Shaaks was scared by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets']] [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] as they approched the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who during that time had been acting as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] after [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|two near-assassinations against her]], attempted to ride one of the Shaaks, although he briefly fell off, causing Padme some concern until it was revealed that he deliberately fell off as a joke.<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Peppi Bow's herd fell victim to a leak of the waterborne [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] from [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]]. She lost six of her shaaks to the plague and almost fell victim herself.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] territorial disputes between shaak wranglers led some wrangling families to hire gangsters that added banned chemicals to the feed of rival shaak herds. The intestinal blockages created by these chemicals eventually caused the shaaks to explode. The [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] had to hire independent agents to eliminate the gangsters.<ref name="SWG:ESP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Exploding Shaak Problem}} on Naboo</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Shaak_AotC.png|thumb|right|180px|A shaak]]
The shaak was designed by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] to suggest a helpless grazer bred large for food, the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] equivalent of a [[Sheep/Legends|sheep]]. They are seen briefly in one shot of ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|The Phantom Menace]]'' as computer generated creations.<ref name=":0">{{DB|creature|shaak|shaak}}</ref>

The shaak was the butt of many jokes among [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] digital artists during production of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']]. The blooper reel on the DVD release includes a shot where a large, digital shaak takes the place of a [[Core ship/Legends|core ship]] brought down by [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA-T]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. In an easter egg on the Attack of the Clones DVD, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] fires lightning from his palm and destroys a shaak. Shaaks also appear as "[[easter egg]]s" in several places in the film itself: floating in the [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] asteroid field and among flaming wreckage at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].<ref>{{SWArchive|url=qa|text=''Star Wars'' Q & A}}</ref>
